ur.text: تفسیر • علمی مؤقف / مفہومی خلاصہ

Al-Sa‘di interprets the healing of the breast in relation to desires that obstruct obedience and doubts that undermine certainty. Guidance includes knowing the truth and acting upon it, linking inward reform with outward conduct.

entries.titleEn: Din in Joseph’s address to his fellow prisoners
entries.titleUr: یوسف کے ہم قید ساتھیوں سے خطاب میں دین

en.text: Tafsir • Scholarly position / paraphrased argument
Al-Tabari reads the passage within Joseph’s rejection of the prisoners’ and their people’s deities. He identifies upright Din here with sincere worship of the one God and abandonment of idol worship.
Source: al-Tabari, Jami‘ al-bayan ‘an ta’wil ay al-Qur’an; commentary on 12:40; opening explanation and the clause “dhalika al-din al-qayyim”.

entries.titleEn: Worship and voluntary devotion: a lexical distinction
entries.titleUr: عبادت اور اختیاری بندگی: لغوی امتیاز

en.text: Scholarly source • Scholarly position / paraphrased argument

Al-Raghib distinguishes showing humility from worship as its most complete form, reserved for Allah as the giver of ultimate beneficence. He further distinguishes subjection by creation from the voluntary worship commanded of responsible beings.
Source: Al-Raghib al-Isfahani, al-Mufradat fi gharib al-Qur’an; entry ‘abd (عبد), opening definition and division of worship.
Relevance / context: Useful for defining worship without reducing it to outward ritual alone.

ur.text: علمی ماخذ • علمی مؤقف / مفہومی خلاصہ
راغب اظہارِ تذلل اور عبادت میں فرق کرتے ہیں؛ عبادت کامل ترین تذلل ہے جو کامل احسان کرنے والے اللہ کے لیے خاص ہے۔ وہ تخلیقی تسخیر اور ذمہ دار مخلوق کو حکم دی گئی اختیاری عبادت میں بھی امتیاز کرتے ہیں۔
ماخذ: راغب اصفہانی، المفردات في غريب القرآن؛ مادہ عبد، ابتدائی تعریف اور عبادت کی تقسیم۔
تعلق / سیاق: عبادت کی تعریف میں مفید، اسے صرف ظاہری رسم تک محدود نہیں کرتا۔
قید / توضیح: غریب کے ذریعے اصل تصنیف کا برقی اندراج دیکھا گیا؛ مخطوطہ یا مخصوص ایڈیشن کا صفحہ نہیں جانچا گیا۔
حیثیت: مخصوص مقام کا ماخذی معائنہ؛ دونوں زبانوں میں مرتب کا مفہومی خلاصہ، مطبوعہ ترجمہ نہیں۔

en.text: Scholarly source • Scholarly position / paraphrased argument

Al-Firuzabadi lists recompense, Islam, custom, worship, obedience, reckoning, authority and other senses under din. These are lexical possibilities, not a requirement to insert every meaning into every Quranic occurrence.
Source: Al-Firuzabadi, al-Qamus al-muhit; root d-y-n, paragraph beginning “al-din, bi-l-kasr”.
Relevance / context: Use alongside Reference 035: neither din nor the English category religion has one context-free definition.

en.text: Scholarly source • Scholarly position / paraphrased argument

Al-Shatibi states that the purpose of placing people under the Sharia is to move them beyond unregulated desire into willing service of Allah. He distinguishes seeking legitimate human interests under divine guidance from making personal preference the measure of every rule.
Source: Al-Shatibi, al-Muwafaqat; Kitab al-Maqasid, purposes of the Lawgiver, fourth type, first issue, statement of purpose and its proofs; digital volume 2.
Relevance / context: Provides a juristic explanation of the importance of Din in moral self-government.
